title: [enhancement] New action "notice" or "sport-entry" set by automation
symptom: The user requests a new automation action to create a notice or sport entry in the care portal, triggered by Bluetooth device connection (e.g., car or heart rate sensor). They want to track times when driving or doing sports without additional software.
evidence_quote: I wish me a new feature in automation. Please make it possible to set a action for making a notice or sport-entry in care-portal.
